arguments.heading: What happened at the argument
paragraphs: The college argues state immunity blocks federal bankruptcy enforcement.
The creditor argues federal bankruptcy laws must bind all states.
Justice Stevens asked why the automatic stay binds the state.
Justice O'Connor asked why sovereign immunity does not extend to the stay.
